propositions: Models fence-wrap quoted JSON and heuristic trailing-object selection allows schema-valid decoys to win, requiring an explicit output channel to guarantee payload location.

Extend schema_directive to instruct models to wrap JSON between line-anchored sentinel markers (<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>> and <<<END>>>) and rewrite parse_structured to extract marker blocks in reverse document order, returning the first valid block and failing closed if markers are present but no block validates.

Marker pairing is line-anchored and non-nested: OPEN...OPEN...END yields one block, OPEN...END...OPEN...END yields two (last wins), incomplete or absent markers fall back to byte-for-byte legacy full-reply selection.

The bounded-retry prompt must name the same markers as the first attempt to keep the fail-closed retry channel consistent and prevent contradictory bare-JSON instructions from breaking layer-4 retry logic.

Unit tests verify marker extraction, last-block-wins semantics, content/marker collision immunity via line-anchoring, empty-block fail-closed behavior, and markerless path regression-free fallthrough; AC5 live measurement confirms per-cell parse-success non-regression and improvement on fenced-output cells.

A discovered follow-up (task 30b0-0004-744b-463e) records that live marker adoption under the matrix proxy was 0/20 despite compliance testing; fail-closed safety and no-decoy-win guarantees are proven offline by deterministic unit oracle (113 tests) independent of live marker emission.
